reason: 一次要旨: Open-source video generative models ship almost exclusively as PyTorch/CUDA reference implementations. This leaves Cloud TPU pods without a production-ready inference path, despite offering large, cost-effective accelerator memory pools ideal for long-sequence spatiotemporal attention. We present vidax, an open-source JAX/Flax inference engine and zero-copy PyTorch-to-JAX weight translator for modern video generation architect
title: vidax: A Unified JAX Framework for Video Generative Models on Accelerator Meshes
